summary_en: SBI Holdings to acquire 100% of Bitbank Co., Ltd. via subsidiary SBICAH through share purchase from founder Hiriosue Noriyuki, MIXI, and Ceres. Deal structure: SBICAH acquires shares for cash, then participates in capital increase; Bitbank subsequently repurchases all holdings of MIXI and Ceres. Combined 2026/4 proforma: ¥1.1T deposits under management, 2.92M crypto accounts (1st place, deposits; top-tier, accounts). Execution conditional on FTC merger clearance.
title_en: Notice of Conclusion of Basic Agreement and Share Transfer Agreement Regarding Share Acquisition of Bitbank Co., Ltd. (Complete Subsidiary Status)
translation_en_brief: On 25 June 2026, SBI Holdings' board approved a basic agreement and share transfer agreement for the complete acquisition of Bitbank Co., Ltd., a cryptocurrency exchange operator, via its wholly-owned subsidiary SBICAH. The transaction involves three steps: (1) SBICAH acquires Bitbank shares from founder/CEO Noriyuki Hiriosue and other individual shareholders for cash; (2) SBICAH subscribes to a third-party capital increase by Bitbank; (3) Bitbank uses proceeds to repurchase all shares held by MIXI and Ceres. Upon completion, SBICAH will hold 100% of Bitbank (indirect voting rights). The acquisition rationale centres on combining SBI's crypto exchange strength (SBI VC Trade) with Bitbank's high-security platform (zero hacking losses since inception) to create a combined operation with approximately ¥1.1 trillion in deposits under management and 2.92 million crypto accounts, positioning the merged entity as the largest by deposits and top-tier by account count domestically. The deal also enables expansion into stablecoin and on-chain finance services. Execution is conditional upon Japan Fair Trade Commission merger clearance and satisfaction of other closing conditions. Share count, purchase price per share, and total consideration are not disclosed in this excerpt.
